text_block_list.text:
The day of the Swan Stakes. When I entered the waiting room,
Hishi Akebono was doing sumo stomps.
As I watched for a moment, he smoothly rinsed his mouth and began scattering salt—

Just when you think she's done, she stands on tiptoe, spreads her legs,
squats down, stands up,
squats down again, and places both hands on the ground in front of her.
choice_data_list: (I feel like I've seen that somewhere before...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew! Alright, time to do my best—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, umm... It's an imitation! Of a ritual!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever seen it? Sumo wrestlers
perform a ritual before their bouts, you know~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You purify the ring and your body,
showing that you're about to fight fair and square~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You know what, today, I'm trembling with excitement way more than usual!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Once I got all fired up to do it, I just couldn't sit still,
so I was performing a ritual~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Somehow, it made me stand at full attention!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Did I get some sumo power?
I feel like I can pull off an amazing reversal today~!

Hishi Akebono is fired up like never before.
The curtain rises on the Swan Stakes!
